component.name: Textrill
component.summary: Convert plain text into well-formed HTML

description.p: Textrill converts plain text to HTML by inferring the structure authors already write: indentation for lists, blank lines for paragraphs, setext rules and underlines for headings, and trailing punctuation for link labels.
No markup language is required. The native editor shows the inferred HTML beside the source, and the output uses templates you control. The tool never uses the network.

ul.li: Setext headings and explicit heading rules
Bullet, ordered and definition lists from layout
Links from URLs, mailto: and a user dictionary
Templates and offline, file-based template packs
Encoding detection and a static command-line binary
